about: Synthetic test life for the memory-structure bake-off (2026-10-30). Fictional person, every fact invented; no owner data. Messages are what the person says to Jarvis, in date order. Questions are asked 'today' = 2026-10-30. Scoring: an answer passes when every group in 'must' has at least one alternative in the answer (case-insensitive) and no 'must_not' term appears; 'abstain' questions pass only when the answer says it doesn't know and states no value. Alternatives of 3 characters or fewer match as whole words only (so 'go' does not match 'good'). BIG version: the same facts and questions plus 1000 everyday messages (make_big_life.py, seed 20261030); none changes a right answer.
